{"rule":"Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, the passage of about 250 words that comes immediately AFTER the current text in the same story.","text":"No one did. The bus closed its doors and pulled away, leaving the corner empty again.

The writer turned the phone over. Mara’s message was still there. They typed, “I know,” but did not send it.

In the story, the woman stood. The boy looked up from his suitcase.

“Where are you going?” he asked.

She pointed toward the door at the end of the platform. “To see.”

The writer paused. They had given the boy a voice without deciding what he wanted. Perhaps he wanted her to stay. Perhaps he was waiting for her to leave so he could follow.

The phone buzzed beneath their hand.

“Sorry,” Mara wrote. “That sounded strange.”

The writer looked toward the kitchen. The tap had stopped dripping. They remembered turning it tighter, though they could not remember when.

On the laptop, they wrote that the woman crossed the platform. She set her hand on the door’s metal handle. It was cold, and wet at the edges where rain had blown through the station. When she turned it, the latch gave.

Beyond the door was a narrow stairwell. A light burned at the bottom. She could not see where the stairs ended.

The boy called to her, but the writer had not yet written what he said.

They picked up the phone and sent the two words they had typed. Then they added, “I’m trying the door.”

For a while, Mara did not answer. The writer left the woman standing at the top of the stairs and went to shut the kitchen tap."}
